mcqs.question: With reference to the performance of districts under the PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana, which pair correctly represents the average district score in April 2026 and August 2026, respectively?
mcqs.explanation: The average district score increased from 18.85 in April 2026 to 46.89 in August 2026, an increase of 28.04 points. The tempting option containing 28.04 as the August score is incorrect because 28.04 denotes the increase, not the August average score.
